headline: Report: Record-breaking Year for Australian Renewables as Battery System Deployments Triple | Empower Stories | Build Authority - Drive Impact
summary: A SunWiz report shows a record 221,000 residential solar battery systems were installed in 2025, three times 2024. Total storage reached 4,790 MWh, with NSW leading state installations.
why: Battery storage paired with rooftop solar is a growing segment of the energy transition, shaping demand for batteries, inverters and grid services.
